abilities.effect: The ladder’s anchors rip free from the wall, dropping the ladder and anyone on it into area B1. Anyone on the ladder falls 50 feet, taking falling damage as appropriate. A creature at the top of the ladder can attempt a DC 21 Acrobatics check or Reflex save to Grab an Edge and cling to the side of the pit in area A9. A creature lower on the ladder can attempt to grab a handhold on the shaft’s wall, but in this case the check increases to DC 25.
abilities.name: Rip Free
abilities.trigger: More than 3 Small creatures or more than 1 Medium creature climbs the ladder at the same time

hazard.description: The rope ladder rips free from its anchors and drops into the pit.
hazard.disable: DC 25 Thievery (trained) or DC 22 Crafting (trained) to secure the ladder’s anchors so they won’t break
hazard.name: Breakaway Ladder

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
